name: 20714 · North Beach, MD
findings: ZIP 20714 (North Beach) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (73%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20714 (North Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
88% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
